values.intro: We're not just a daycare. We're the first public space where a child learns that they are welcome exactly as they are — and that shapes everything we do.

items.title: Safety
items.body: Every kindergarten meets the highest standards of physical and emotional safety — from certified premises to trained staff.

items.title: Development
items.body: Age-appropriate play and curriculum. The program follows each child's strengths instead of forcing them into a mold.

items.title: Inclusion
items.body: Children of different abilities, languages, and backgrounds grow together. A network of special educators, speech therapists, and pedagogues is available to every family.

items.title: Learning
items.body: We collaborate with faculties of the University of Sarajevo. Our educators continually train so children get the best.

day.intro: A predictable rhythm helps a child feel safe. Our daily plan leaves room for curiosity, and for rest too — because little heads need both.

header.intro: We've been caring for Sarajevo's youngest citizens for as long as we can remember. We change our methods, but never the core principle — the child is at the center of everything we do.

mission.title: To create the safest, fairest, and most curious environment for preschool children in Canton Sarajevo.
mission.body: Our duty is not just to look after children — our duty is to make sure every child leaves our kindergartens ready for primary school and, more importantly, for the world.

vision.title: To be a place where every child finds their voice, a friend, and a first reason to love learning.
vision.body: We see a Sarajevo where the preschool years are the happiest years of childhood — and where every parent trusts the public institution.

items.b: The City Assembly of Sarajevo founds a unified preschool institution with 8 kindergartens.
During the siege the work doesn't stop — improvised spaces, food from humanitarian aid.
An integrated child-development program is introduced, modeled on „Reggio Emilia".
A network of special educators and speech therapists launches across all facilities.
Today we care for more than 3,200 children in 14 facilities across Sarajevo.

org.intro: Our institution employs 412 people — from educators and special educators to cooks and caretakers. Each has a role in the daily rhythm of the kindergarten.

header.intro: Every one of our kindergartens has its own personality — a yard, a team, a favorite song. See details, contacts, and specific programs below.

kindergartens.moreNote: And 8 more kindergartens with profiles in progress — available soon.

header.intro: We've made the process so it can be done in a single afternoon. Read the requirements, gather your documents, and apply — we handle the rest.

conditions.title: Short and clear.
items: Child aged 6 months until entering primary school (up to age 6).
Residence of one or both parents within Canton Sarajevo.
Child with no acute infections at the start of attendance.
Consent of both parents, or guardians, to the institution's terms.

docs.title: Five papers.
items: Birth certificate (original or a copy certified at the Municipality).
CIPS residence registration of parents (not older than 6 months).
Proof of employment of both parents, or an equivalent substitute document.
Pediatrician's medical certificate (not older than 7 days before attendance starts).
Proof of specific needs, if any (medical, pedagogical).

form.intro: All data stays strictly within the institution and is processed in line with BiH's Personal Data Protection Act. Takes about 6 minutes.

form.consent: I consent to the processing of personal data and have read the Privacy Policy of JU „Djeca Sarajeva".

items.q: Can I enroll my child online?
items.a: Yes. Online enrollment is available through this site. After applying online, original documents must be brought to the institution's administration within 7 days.

items.q: How are applications scored when there are more children than spots?
items.a: The scoring system, defined by the Rulebook, includes parents' employment status, number of children in the family, residence, the child's specific needs, and existing enrolled siblings. The full table is in the Documents section.

items.q: Is there a fee for the child's stay at the kindergarten?
items.a: Yes, there is a monthly participation fee per the Canton Sarajevo Government's Decision. The amount depends on family income and the number of children at the same kindergarten; subsidies are available.

items.q: What if my child has an allergy or a special diet?
items.a: Our kitchens prepare dietary meals. At enrollment you submit a pediatrician's certificate with precise instructions, and kindergarten staff individually monitor each case.
Yes. We offer half-day (4 hours) and full-day (up to 10.5 hours) attendance. You choose one of the schedules at the time of application.

The Council is made up of parents from all 14 kindergartens. It meets monthly, makes recommendations, and oversees our work from the perspective of those who care most.
